data.situation:
The museum reply arrived on Friday, a day later than expected. It offered a group visit next month, so Lin and Maya returned to the library window table at two. A desktop computer was available even though the portable equipment was still booked out. They opened a virtual tour of the museum in its ordinary browser. They followed its room arrows to the courtyard. An increasing number of requests had filled the museum's group slots. The delay would affect their plans for the next display, but the website let them look at the objects that afternoon. One label described a monument built to honour the town's rescue volunteers. The older computer was prone to freezing when several picture windows were open, so Maya closed two. On the feedback form, Lin noted the problem. Then they returned to the story recording and tried the two endings with headphones. Lin to the reading group:
The reply arrived today, a day later than expected. The museum can offer us a visit next month. Increasing demand has filled this month's group slots, which will affect our display plans. Today Maya and I took the virtual tour instead. We found the monument label we wanted to read. We'll bring our notes and the two recorded endings to the next meeting.

readingBlocks.zh: 博物馆的回复周五才到，比预期晚了一天。回复提供了下个月的团体参观时段，于是林和玛雅两点回到图书馆窗边桌。虽然便携设备仍被借走，桌面电脑还能使用。她们用普通浏览器打开博物馆的虚拟导览，沿网页上的展厅箭头走到庭院页面。不断增加的预约申请已经占满了团体名额。这次推迟会影响下一场展示的计划，不过她们那天下午仍能在网站上看看藏品。其中一张标签介绍了一座为纪念小镇救援志愿者而建的纪念碑。这台旧电脑一开好几个图片窗口就容易卡住，玛雅便关掉了两个。林在反馈表上记下这个问题，随后两人返回故事录音，戴上耳机试听两个结尾。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin to the reading group:
The reply arrived today, a day later than expected. The museum can offer us a visit next month. Increasing demand has filled this month's group slots, which will affect our display plans. Today Maya and I took the virtual tour instead. We found the monument label we wanted to read. We'll bring our notes and the two recorded endings to the next meeting.
readingBlocks.zh:
林给读书小组的消息：
回复今天才到，比预期晚了一天。博物馆能安排我们下个月参观。不断增加的需求已经占满了本月团体名额，这会影响我们的展示计划。今天玛雅和我改看了虚拟导览，也找到了想读的纪念碑标签。下次见面时，我们会带上笔记和录好的两个结尾。

glossary.note: affect +宾语，说明参观推迟影响展示安排；动词。
glossary.example: The delay would affect their plans for the next display, but the website let them look at the objects that afternoon.
glossary.exampleZh: 这次推迟会影响下一场展示的计划，不过她们那天下午仍能在网站上看看藏品。

glossary.zh: 数量正在增加的（形容词所选义）
glossary.note: an increasing number of requests/Increasing demand表示数量持续增多的，increasing作定语。
glossary.example: An increasing number of requests had filled the museum's group slots.
glossary.exampleZh: 不断增加的预约申请已经占满了博物馆的团体名额。

glossary.zh: 为纪念某人或事件而建造的建筑或雕塑
glossary.note: monument为纪念人物或事件而建的物件；标签明确纪念救援志愿者。
glossary.example: One label described a monument built to honour the town's rescue volunteers.
glossary.exampleZh: 其中一张标签介绍了一座为纪念小镇救援志愿者而建的纪念碑。

externalEvidence.definition: a structure erected to commemorate persons or events

glossary.zh: 容易出现某种不良情况的；prone to
glossary.note: prone to freezing表示容易卡住，to后接名词或-ing形式。
glossary.example: The older computer was prone to freezing when several picture windows were open, so Maya closed two.
glossary.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑一开好几个图片窗口就容易卡住，玛雅便关掉了两个。

externalEvidence.definition: having a tendency (to); often used in combination

glossary.zh: 通过数字界面远程浏览某个地点的虚拟导览
glossary.note: virtual tour为通过浏览器远程浏览博物馆，不要求戴VR头显。
glossary.example: They opened a virtual tour of the museum in its ordinary browser.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们用普通浏览器打开博物馆的虚拟导览。
